build_iodine_vae: build an IODINE iterative amortized variational autoencoder with a decoder, refinement core, and latent distribution
encode_images_iteratively: encode images into per-object latent variables using the iterative refinement encoder over multiple timesteps
decode_latents_to_distribution: decode latent variables z into a spatial mixture output distribution with pixel and mask parameters
evaluate_iodine_model: evaluate the IODINE model on data and return reconstructions, masks, latent variables, and ARI metrics
generate_prior_samples: generate sample images by sampling from the prior distribution and decoding through the model
